fixed.summary: A step with a `target` dims the screen around the element of that `name` (anywhere in the UI; name a View around an Icon), which stays lit and keeps its own presses while the shade takes every other, and its card stands under that element instead of at x and y, as the Svelte screen's spotlight did. `target` now names the element by its `name` prop; empty still dims nothing and stands the card at x and y.
The label and the score stand on the pack's plate (Plate.frame) instead of bare over the scene, where they fell under the contrast bar.
A resource's rate and note are never clipped to the width of its amount ("+0/s" drew as "+0/").
